## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X326 in eight fascicles is [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85) (Hānshān Déqīng, 1546–1623)'s major commentary on *[Léngqiéābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* (T670). The work belongs to the late-Míng monastic-Buddhist revival of the *Laṅkāvatāra* — a project Hānshān shared with his contemporaries [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) (cf. [KR6i0345](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0345), [KR6i0346](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0346)) and [通潤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E6%BD%A4) ([KR6i0348](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0348)).

**Abstract**

Date bracket follows Hānshān's late productive period (post-1606 partial rehabilitation, pre-death 1623); the consensus dating among modern scholars (Sung-peng Hsu 1979, Wu Jiang 2008) is during his Cáoxī period in Guǎngdōng. The commentary is doctrinally syncretic in the late-Míng manner: Chán meditative applications, Yogācāra eight-consciousness analytics, Tiāntái doctrinal categories, and Pure-Land devotional interpretations are all drawn upon as the parent sūtra warrants. As a working *jì* commentary on T670, X326 is roughly contemporaneous with [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s [X328](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0345) (*xuányì*) and [X329](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0346) (*yìshū*); the three together (with [通潤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E6%BD%A4)'s [X331](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0348) and [曾鳳儀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%BE%E9%B3%B3%E5%84%80)'s [X330](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0347)) constitute the late-Míng commentarial canonisation of the *Laṅkāvatāra*.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670); Hānshān's supplementary [KR6i0344](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0344) (楞伽補遺); contemporaneous commentaries [KR6i0345](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0345), [KR6i0346](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0346), [KR6i0347](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0347), [KR6i0348](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0348).
